protocol_reason: Pinned Hermes v2026.9.24 answered ping, client.capabilities, and session.create over newline-delimited JSON-RPC on stdio. Server requests include approval and clarify. ACP and the HTTP API stay unused.
tool_interception: Dangerous shell waits on the gateway approval server-request (tools/approval.py, request method approval). That is a real hold point. Browser, terminal, and computer_use can still run inside Hermes if those toolsets are enabled, so a UI-only policy would not cover them. This project disables those toolsets with agent.disabled_toolsets and runs Mac workflows through coordinator executors instead of patching Hermes.

openmuse_runtime: The OpenMuse app was not started. Its server requires a CopilotKit Intelligence key and its UI packages are excluded. Review rules were adapted into packages/task-logic and run there.
